title: MI5 Chief Warns of Escalating Hybrid Threats From Iran and Russia on British Soil
summary: The head of Britain’s domestic security agency accused Tehran and Moscow of escalating their hybrid campaigns in the U.K., and called Iran-led attacks on Jewish communities “sickening.”
